title: Excel Just Changed Your ID 😬 #excel #csv #datacleaning
description: Excel can silently remove leading zeros or reinterpret long numeric-looking identifiers. This animated workflow shows a safer CSV import path: Data → From Text/CSV → Transform Data → set identifier columns to Text → Load. #excel #csv #datacleaning #productivity
visual_style: 3D identifier tunnel and protected import pipeline

captions.text: Excel can change an ID before you touch the file.
IDs are not numbers just because they use digits.
Transform Data → set the ID column to Text.
Then load with the original values preserved.
Sometimes digits are identity, not math.
